```{=html}
<div id="figure-editor" class="fe-mount"></div>
<noscript><p>The figure editor needs JavaScript.</p></noscript>
<script type="module">
  import { mount } from "./src/app.js";
  mount(document.getElementById("figure-editor"), {
    pack: "./symbol-pack/",
    open: new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("open"),
  });
</script>
```
